parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the scroll wheel of a computer mouse, typically made of rubber for grip and comfort.
parts.Functional_description: The wheel allows the user to scroll vertically or horizontally through content on a screen and can also act as a middle button when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis and can be pressed down slightly for a click action.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the computer mouse, made of durable ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal components such as sensors, circuit board, and buttons, and provides the ergonomic shape for hand placement.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to the internal components but moves as a whole across a surface to control the cursor on the screen.
